tools.name: search_poll_archive

tools.name: get_election

tools.name: get_track_record

tools.name: get_constituency

tools.name: find_constituency_by_postcode

tools.name: get_constituency_race
tools.description: Who wins the direct mandate in a constituency: win probability per party, margin, rating.

tools.name: get_constituency_dossier
tools.description: Everything on one Bundestag constituency in one call: structure data, postcodes, results since 2013, 2029 forecast, direct-mandate chances, its members (committees, speeches, votes), state government and next state election.

tools.name: get_constituency_results
tools.description: Official Bundestag results of a constituency 2013 to 2025 (first and second vote, turnout).

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: All members of the Bundestag with party, constituency and mandate type.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: One member of the Bundestag: profile, committees, documents, latest speeches, roll-call record.

tools.name: get_member_votes
tools.description: Roll-call votes of one member with title, date and whether against the party line.

tools.name: get_member_side_income
tools.description: Side jobs and side income of one member of the Bundestag (published brackets, organisations, categories).

tools.name: list_side_income
tools.description: Side income of all members of the Bundestag: ranking and totals per party, filter by party, category and minimum amount.

tools.name: search_lobby_register
tools.description: Search the German Bundestag lobby register (organisations): name, field of interest, type, minimum lobbying spend.

tools.name: lobbying_ranking
tools.description: Who spends most on lobbying in Germany: top organisations, totals per field of interest and type.

tools.name: get_lobby_register_entry
tools.description: One entry of the German lobby register by register number (e.g. R001234).

tools.name: list_party_donations
tools.description: Large donations to German parties as published by the Bundestag (above 35,000 euros, until March 2024 above 50,000 euros, itemised since 2009): donor, amount, dates, printed paper, totals per party.

tools.name: get_attention
tools.description: Attention from Wikipedia page views per day: German parties and the leading candidates of the next elections (Bundestag, Saarland, Schleswig-Holstein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Spain, France). Not a forecast.

tools.name: get_germany_electricity
tools.description: German electricity per day: generation by source, renewable share, consumption, wholesale price (incl. next day).

tools.name: get_europe_energy_prices
tools.description: Household electricity and gas prices in all EU countries (Eurostat), ranked, with change to the previous half-year.

tools.name: get_gas_storage
tools.description: Gas storage in the EU and every EU country with storage (GIE AGSI+): fill level, stored TWh, injection and withdrawal, change in 7 days, versus last year and the five-year average, daily series.

tools.name: get_lng_terminals
tools.description: LNG terminals (GIE ALSI): send-out, tank inventory and utilisation for the EU, each country and every German terminal (Wilhelmshaven, Brunsbüttel, Mukran), versus last year, daily series.

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Petrol (Euro-super 95) and diesel prices in all EU countries per week (EU Weekly Oil Bulletin), with and without taxes, EU average, Germany versus EU, rank, weekly series.

tools.name: get_european_parliament
tools.description: European Parliament 2024: seats per political group, EU-wide and per country (official results).

tools.name: compare_eu_countries
tools.description: All 27 EU countries compared: unemployment, inflation, household electricity and gas prices, strongest list in the 2024 European election.

tools.name: get_eu_country
tools.description: One EU country: head of government and state, coalition, national parliament seats by party with governing parties, next national election, European election 2024 results, unemployment, inflation, energy prices.

tools.name: get_france_presidential_2027
tools.description: French presidential election 2027, first round: poll average, 95 percent band and runoff chance per candidate, most likely runoff pairs, recent campaign events. Unavailable during the legal blackout (Saturday 00:00 until 20:00 on election day, Paris time: 17 to 18 Apr and 1 to 2 May 2027).

tools.name: get_france_runoff_2027
tools.description: French presidential election 2027, runoff: head-to-head poll average and win probability per tested pair. Unavailable during the legal blackout (17 to 18 Apr and 1 to 2 May 2027).

tools.name: list_france_polls_2027
tools.description: French presidential election 2027: all first-round polls with every scenario, runoff polls, sample, fieldwork and link to the official Commission des sondages notice. Unavailable during the legal blackout (17 to 18 Apr and 1 to 2 May 2027).

tools.name: get_spain_general_2026
tools.description: Spanish general election 29 Nov 2026: seats per list (median and range), poll average, majority chances. Blackout 24 to 29 Nov (art. 69.7 LOREG). After polls close: official count (seats, vote share, counted percent), forecast for comparison.

tools.name: get_spain_provinces_2026
tools.description: Spanish general election 2026, all 52 constituencies: median seats per list, vote share, seat order, last seat. Blackout 24 to 29 Nov 2026. After polls close: official count per constituency, forecast for comparison.

tools.name: get_german_state
tools.description: One German state (Land): parliament seats by group with majority and governing groups, cabinet with portfolios, 13 official statistics with German value and rank, next state election with our forecast.

tools.name: list_european_elections
tools.description: Next national election in all 27 EU countries and Switzerland: type, date or year, status (official, legal deadline, expected), sources, link to our forecast where available.

tools.name: list_roll_call_votes
tools.description: Recorded roll-call votes in the Bundestag with result per parliamentary group and dissenters.

tools.name: get_committees
tools.description: All Bundestag committees with official name, chair and members (role, group).

tools.name: search_speeches
tools.description: Search Bundestag plenary speeches by member, keyword and date: speaker, date, excerpt, protocol PDF.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search Bundestag printed papers (motions, minor interpellations) by keyword, type and date with authors and PDF.

tools.name: get_institutes
tools.description: Polling institutes: accuracy of final polls in past elections and average bias per party.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: Today's political situation in Germany in a few paragraphs (German), based on the model. Optional date YYYY-MM-DD for a past day.

tools.name: get_governments
tools.description: Who governs federally and in each of the 16 states: coalition, head of government, since when.

tools.name: get_election_statistics
tools.description: Federal election statistics: postal-vote, ticket-splitting, age-groups or turnout.

tools.name: get_live_results
tools.description: Election night: counted share, turnout, results so far and deviation from the forecast.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_election_statistics · Private data: get_track_record, get_member, search_documents · Public sink: get_election, get_germany_electricity, get_lng_terminals, get_spain_general_2026, get_spain_provinces_2026, get_live_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_election_statistics · Private data: get_track_record, get_member, search_documents · Public sink: get_election, get_germany_electricity, get_lng_terminals, get_spain_general_2026, get_spain_provinces_2026, get_live_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
